2024_179_apr_2024_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction register for April 2024, submitted to the Board of Education for the June 20, 2024 meeting and printed 6/13/2024 across 38 pages. Every line carries a transaction description with its posting date, the journal-entry description "APR 2024 PCARD EXP", a fifteen-digit budget-unit string, a four-digit account code, and either a transaction amount or a credit. The register closes with a Subtotal of 310,749.73 in charges and 3,989.93 in credits, and Total Expenses of 306,759.80. The single largest charge is 5,946.15 to WESTIN KANSA against budget unit 700070399323500.

**What it is**
Purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT covering April 2024, carried on the June 20, 2024 Board of Education agenda. The page header repeats "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, April 2024" with column labels Transaction Description / JE Description / Budget Unit / A/C Code / Transaction Amount / Credits.
